date_evidence: The 2004 source states electronically published 2004-10-29; an earlier Stanford report is identified only by month and year and is not assigned a fabricated day.

integrity.computer_checks: Exact rational boundary checks and 490 dense eigenvalues; finite tests are not universal proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Dihedral averaging, Fourier eigenblocks, monotone spectral lower bound, exact integer rational cutoff bounds.

scientific_limitations: Global optimum and invariant uniqueness hold for gear graphs with at least eleven outer sectors; no unrestricted uniqueness claim.
At ten sectors the saturated invariant design is nonoptimal, but full optimal weights below eleven are not classified.
Other graph-specific exact FMMC literature might exist beyond examined source records.
title: The eleven-sector saturation threshold for fastest mixing on gear graphs
